rationale.A: ~730 m in traffic on tram streets (Asemapäällikönkatu, Ratamestarinkatu, Kumpulantie), 7 lights
rationale.B: Side paths beside Teollisuuskatu (50 km/h) most of the way; no mixed traffic, 7 lights
rationale.C: Side paths beside Aleksis Kiven katu and Teollisuuskatu; no mixed traffic, 7 lights
rationale.D: Vallila valley path then Hermannin rantatie side path and Vanha talvitie; no traffic, 5 lights, +2 min
rationale.E: ~410 m on Aleksis Kiven katu in traffic incl. tram rails
rationale.F: Same as D with a longer Hermannin rantatie side path; 7 lights
rationale.G: Quiet Vallila residential streets, 260 m on Elimäenkatu in traffic, Teollisuuskatu side path
rationale.H: Vallila valley and Kangasalantie, short Hämeentie side tracks; 4 lights, +4 min

notes: D removes A's tram-street carriageway riding for +2 min and saves 2 lights, so it covers both cards. H saves 3 lights but costs 4 min.
